summary.text: Tom Southworth is a Democratic state representative for New Hampshire House of Representatives Strafford 11 who has served in the House since 2014, according to Ballotpedia, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is an educator by profession.

paragraphs.text: Southworth earned a B.A. in education from Dartmouth College and an M.Ed. from Keene State College.
His career experience includes working as a reading teacher, a school counselor and an education administrator, and he has served on the board of the Dover Children's Center.
Southworth won elections for Strafford 20 in 2018 and 2020, and in 2022 he was elected in Strafford 11 together with Janet Wall and Hoy Menear.
He was assigned to the Ways and Means Committee in the 2015, 2017, 2019-2020 and 2023-2024 sessions.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026.
